name: UAL239 · 晴空颠簸与跑道关闭

cards.taskTitle: 38. UAL239 · 晴空颠簸与跑道关闭-1
cards.audioText: Your call sign is UAL239, from New York to Wuhan. You are maintaining 11000m ETA OBLIK at 55, squawk 3566. Call Wuhan Control.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是美联航239，从纽约飞往武汉，11000米保持，预计到达OBLIK时间55分，应答机3566，呼叫武汉区调。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, UAL239, maintaining 11000m ETA OBLIK 55, squawk 3566.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，美联航239，11000米保持，预计到达OBLIK时间55分，应答机3566。

cards.taskTitle: 38. UAL239 · 晴空颠簸与跑道关闭-2
cards.audioText: UAL239, Wuhan Control, radar contact, descend and maintain 9200m, expedite descend until passing 9800m due crossing traffic.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航239，武汉区调，雷达已识别，下降保持9200米，由于交叉活动，快速下降通过9800米。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Descend and maintain 9200m, expedite descent until passing 9800m, UAL239.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降保持9200米，由于交叉活动，快速下降通过9800米，美联航239。

cards.taskTitle: 38. UAL239 · 晴空颠簸与跑道关闭-3
cards.audioText: You are now maintaining 9200m. You are experiencing moderate clear air turbulence (CAT). Inform ATC of this situation and request further descend and maintain 8400m.
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行高度9200米保持。你正在经历中度晴空乱流。通知ATC该情况并请求进一步下降8400米保持。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, UAL239, maintaining 9200m. Request further descent to 8400m due moderate clear air turbulence.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，美联航239，9200米保持。由于晴空乱流，请求进一步下降8400米。

cards.taskTitle: 38. UAL239 · 晴空颠簸与跑道关闭-4
cards.audioText: UAL239, continue descend and maintain 8400m, report reaching.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航239，继续下降保持8400米保持，到达报告。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Continue descend and maintain 8400m, report reaching. UAL239.
cards.referenceTextZh: 继续下降保持8400米保持，到达报，美联航239。

cards.taskTitle: 38. UAL239 · 晴空颠簸与跑道关闭-5
cards.audioText: TCAS shows a fast moving aircraft at 9 o'clock. Check with Wuhan Control if it is a conflicting traffic.
cards.audioTextZh: TCAS显示9点钟方向有一架快速移动的飞机，和武汉区调核实是否有冲突活动。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, UAL239, TCAS shows a traffic at 9 o'clock. Is it a conflicting aircraft?
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，美联航239，TCAS显示9点钟方位有活动。是冲突飞机么？

cards.taskTitle: 38. UAL239 · 晴空颠簸与跑道关闭-6
cards.audioText: UAL239, negative, that aircraft is military aircraft flying parallel to your current track and will overtake you shortly. Report traffic in sight.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航239，不是，那是一架军用飞机，正沿你当前航迹平行飞行，不久就会超过你。能见飞机报告。【复诵】

cards.taskTitle: 38. UAL239 · 晴空颠簸与跑道关闭-7
cards.audioText: Now that aircraft has passed you. Report to ATC.
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, UAL239, the traffic is cleared.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，美联航239，航空器解除冲突。

cards.taskTitle: 38. UAL239 · 晴空颠簸与跑道关闭-8
cards.audioText: UAL239, reduce to minimum speed. Fly direct to ZF, expect ZF-3 arrival runway 36R.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航239，速度减至最小。直飞ZF，预计ZF-3进场，跑道36右。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Minimum speed. Direct to ZF, ZF-3 arrival runway 36R, UAL239.
cards.referenceTextZh: 最小速度。直飞ZF，ZF-3进场，跑道36右，美联航239。

cards.taskTitle: 38. UAL239 · 晴空颠簸与跑道关闭-9
cards.audioText: UAL239, continue descend and maintain 4200m.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航239，继续下降保持4200米。【复诵】

cards.taskTitle: 38. UAL239 · 晴空颠簸与跑道关闭-10
cards.audioText: You are now leveling off at 4200m and approaching ZF, information A received, make an initial contact with Wuhan Approach.
cards.audioTextZh: 你正在4200米平飞，接近ZF，收到通播A，和武汉进近进行初次联系。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, UAL239, approaching ZF, maintaining 4200m, information A.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，美联航239，接近ZF，4200米保持，通播A。

cards.taskTitle: 38. UAL239 · 晴空颠簸与跑道关闭-11
cards.audioText: UAL239, Wuhan Approach, radar contact.[Now you have established ILS approach runway 36R, contact Wuhan Tower.]
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航239，武汉进近，雷达已识别。【你已建立盲降进近跑道36右，联系武汉塔台。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, UAL239, established ILS runway 36R.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，美联航239，建立盲降进近跑道36右。

cards.taskTitle: 38. UAL239 · 晴空颠簸与跑道关闭-12
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航239，继续进近跑道36右。【复诵】
cards.referenceTextZh: 继续进近跑道36右，美联航239。

cards.taskTitle: 38. UAL239 · 晴空颠簸与跑道关闭-13
cards.audioText: All stations! All stations! Be advised runway 36R is closed due an unserviceable aircraft occupying the runway. Break, UAL239, fly heading 360, climb and maintain 1500m.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 全体注意！全体注意！由于停放一架故障飞机，跑道36右关闭。还有，美联航239，航向360，上升保持1500米。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Roger, heading 360, climb and maintain 1500m, UAL239.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，航向360，上升保持1500米，美联航239。

cards.taskTitle: 38. UAL239 · 晴空颠簸与跑道关闭-14
cards.audioText: UAL239, turn right heading 170, expect radar vectors for VOR/DME approach runway 04.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航239，右转航向170，雷达引导VOR/DME进近跑道04。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Right heading 170, radar vectors for VOR/DME approach runway 04, UAL239
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向170，雷达引导VOR/DME进近跑道04，美联航239。

cards.taskTitle: 38. UAL239 · 晴空颠簸与跑道关闭-15
cards.audioText: UAL239, turn right heading 310, cleared for the VOR/DME approach runway 04, report inbound.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航239，右转航向310，可以VOR/DME进近跑道04，向台报告。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Right heading 310, cleared for VOR/DME approach runway 04, report inbound, UAL239.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向310，可以VOR/DME进近跑道04，向台报告，美联航239。

cards.taskTitle: 38. UAL239 · 晴空颠簸与跑道关闭-16
cards.audioText: You are now inbound course for runway 04, contact Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: 【你在跑道04入台航道，联系武汉塔台。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, UAL239, VOR/DME approach runway 04.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，美联航239，VOR/DME进近跑道04。
